$comment: The decision surface of pkinative under semantic versioning (ADR 0014), generated by scripts/build-refusals-frozen.ts from scripts/data/limbo-refusals.json: every x509-limbo certificate parseCertificate refuses under the default options, by the SHA-256 of its DER, with the PkiErrorCode it is refused with, as verified by conformance L1 at "commit". The refusal-baseline-frozen rule of scripts/verify-docs.ts fails when a refusal listed here leaves the baseline or changes code, and conformance L1 fails when the corpus holds a listed certificate and the engine does not refuse it with that code: both are semver-major. phase "rehearsal" (0.9.x): no refusal may be added either. phase "stable" (from 1.0.0): a new refusal is a recorded security or conformance fix, semver-minor — the release that ships it adds it here with its "since", and its release note lists it under "### Decision surface". "retired" holds refusals whose certificate a corpus re-pin dropped, with the commit they were last verified at and the ADR that records the re-pin: still promised. Path verdicts, diagnostics, limit defaults and scores are not part of this file.
